name: KURT Midsleeper in Acacia
description: The Parisot Kurt Mid Sleeper in Light Acacia is a very popular choice with any family who requires storage but may not have the space. The Parisot Kurt Mid Sleeper in Light Acacia is a very popular choice with any family who requires storage but may not have the space. The Parisot Kurt Mid Sleeper incorporates a free standing desk, shelving and a two door cupboard. The ladder on this Parisot Kurt Mid Sleeper is on the right hand side with deep sturdy steps. Mattress: We have a selection of mattress options available for this unit. The Irish bed base standard size is 190cmx90cm, the bed bases are 200cm in length. Our 190cmx90cm & 200cmx90cm mattresses are both suitable for this base, however for our customers we recommend the 190cmx90cm mattress as the fit allows greater ease in fitting and changing bed sheets. Please note if purchasing the 90x190cm you will have a gap of 10cm at the end of the bed. Should you wish to purchase 90x200cm please contact us directly.
